revenue_source_agreement_claim.claim: pos_transactions.gross_revenue and finance_gl_extract.gl_revenue_usd agree on revenue for the same region-month, within tolerance

refutes_if.rationale: A systematic gap this size can't be sampling noise across every region-month -- it means the two sources are computing revenue on different definitions.

revenue_source_agreement_claim.explanation: Systematic ~2.0% gap, consistent across every region-month (not random noise). Documented cause in the KPI contract: 'net of a 2% returns/discount allowance not applied in pos_transactions.gross_revenue'. Treat pos_transactions.gross_revenue as the analysis series (it is the declared system-of-record for the `revenue` KPI); finance_gl_extract is kept as a reconciliation check, not swapped in silently.
